title: Build Plan
description: Deterministic local planning stub produced by factory plan from a project_brief.

manufacturing_goal.description: Human-readable summary of what this project is trying to manufacture, derived from the brief description.

target_printer.description: Best-effort resolution of brief.json's intended_printer against config/manufacturing/printers.json. Reference/advisory only - never used to connect to or control a printer.

assembly.description: Whether this plan currently reflects a single-part or multi-part project.

materials.description: Deterministic, keyword-based material candidates from config/manufacturing/materials.json - not a final material decision.

colors.description: Final color decisions per part - always empty from `factory plan`; a human fills this in.

manufacturing_options.description: Every manufacturing option (single-piece, multipart variants, replaceable components) explained with advantages/disadvantages, plus one non-binding recommendation. See factory.manufacturing.decision_engine.

selected_manufacturing_option.description: Always null from `factory plan`. Only a human, editing build_plan.json directly, may set this to one of manufacturing_options.options[].option_id.

unanswered_questions.description: Open decisions a human must resolve before this plan is considered final.
